method: Forecast typical driving ranges, not a drive test or guarantee. Prefer a route with an upper typical estimate no greater than 45 minutes in both directions. Pomroy’s best lower estimate is already 45 minutes and all route upper estimates exceed 45, so it fails a reliable 45-minute commute. Birch Bluff fits via the explicitly noted alternative. Route links open directions; reproduce the date and times above to inspect the forecast.
